actions.label: Allow FWB staff or FWB-chosen assistants to manage food disbursement directly
Hand over distribution organisation to guard and militia structures
Provide an ongoing, recurring food supply to the camp
Provide food rations or compensation to guards and their families
Permit FWB nutritional assessments and documentation under escort
Consult refugees directly about their needs
Pursue government funding for guard pay and generator costs instead of using refugee food
Use vetted local actors and host-town residents as distribution assistants
Commit not to confiscate or divert delivered FWB food
Organise and run food distribution through guards and militia
Include guards or militia in a joint distribution team with FWB staff
Distribute food equally to all refugee groups without skimming

goals.label: Camp generators and power for security keep running
Camp operating costs and guard pay are funded by government or others
Camp receives an ongoing food supply
Camp stays stable, with no riots, unrest or perimeter breach
Commander and guards control food distribution in the camp
Commander's standing with the Senior Militia Leader
Distributions are documented and accountable to donor requirements
FWB assessments and procedures such as nutritional surveys and documentation are applied in the camp
FWB controls food distribution through its own staff or chosen assistants
FWB staff have sufficient access and movement in the camp to deliver aid
FWB's neutrality and impartiality are maintained
Food aid is diverted to guards or militia instead of refugees
Food is distributed fairly and equally to all refugee groups
Guards and their families are fed and paid, keeping them loyal and disciplined
Host town economy and goodwill, with local actors prioritised
Refugees are consulted about their needs
Refugees remain contained in the camp, away from the capital
Commander's image of strength before guards and refugees
FWB food aid programme is sustained with continued access
Refugees receive enough food and adequate nutrition

redLines.label: Hire and source from known local actors such as MASHA
redLines.quote: If FWB hires local independent laborers for the food distribution, you cannot trust those people not to stir unrest and even potentially support hidden terrorists by sharing items or information.

assumptions: Commitments are binding and additive.
Goals and goal-action links were each extracted 3 times by a model; only those found in a majority of runs are kept.
Actions are chosen to bring about as much goal value as possible, within the solver's size limit.
Our values are the median of stances elicited from our role card.
The opponent column is the expected value of an elicited stance distribution (shared documents only); each opponent reading is one draw from it, independently per goal.
Stance labels map to numbers by a fixed scale (game.stance_values), not a measured utility.

Red lines and must-haves come from our role card, each with a verbatim quote. No plan may include a red-line action, leave out a must-have, or pass through a state worth less to us than our BATNA (the bottom line).
